evidence_items.explanation: The original February submission demonstrates attacks delivered through retrieved, poisoned content. It describes demonstrations in synthetic applications, so the initial result should not be overstated as a comprehensive production-system test.

evidence_items.locator: VII Discussion and Limitations, Defense Limitations
evidence_items.explanation: The study documents continuing vulnerability with the tested prompt-based defenses. It also supplies material qualification: fine-tuning defenses drove attack success close to zero on tested Vicuna models, while the authors acknowledged limited benchmark coverage and simulated samples.
